channel.title: Percy incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Percy's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Percy builds were degraded for ~50 mins due to an existing Google Cloud Provider incident [7.30 AM PDT to 8.20 AM PDT on 13th July] [resolved]
item.description:
Percy builds were degraded for ~50 mins [7.30 AM PDT to 8.20 AM PDT on 13th July] due to an existing Google Cloud Provider incident We have moved our infrastructure from the impacted GCP node pool and are back to normal processing
GCP incident details - https://console.cloud.google.com/servicehealth/incidentDetails/projects%2Fpercy-prod%2Flocations%2Fglobal%2Fevents%2FZBYNZVS?project=percy-prod&tab=full-history

item.title: Percy customers were facing intermittent login issues from 7:45 pm PDT to 10:14 PM PDT on 6th July [resolved]
item.description: Percy customers were facing intermittent login issues from 7:45 pm PDT to 10:14 PM PDT on 6th July We have identified the issue and login functionality has been fully restored

item.title: A subset of Percy builds experienced slowness from 4:15 PM PDT to 5 PM PDT [29th June] [resolved]
item.description: A subset of Percy builds experienced slowness from 4:15 PM PDT to 5 PM PDT [29th June] The issue is identified and resolved, services are operating normally

item.title: Intermittent API issue causing missing snapshots or build creation [resolved]
item.description:
In the 20 mins duration some customers might have seen some missing snapshots in the build or failures in creating builds themselves with the 401 status code on the Percy CLI logs.
We have fixed the issue and monitoring the stack.

item.title: Intermittent Login Issues Impacting Some Customers [resolved]
item.description: Percy experienced login failures for a subset of users between 11:54 PM PDT (18 May) – 12:54 AM PDT (19 May) We have identified the issue and login functionality has been fully restored

item.title: Percy builds processing taking longer than usual [resolved]
item.description: Between 4:30 AM and 9:30 AM PDT on May 11, 2026, some Percy builds took longer than usual to complete due to increased database contention. Builds were not lost - only delayed. The issue has been mitigated and processing times are back to normal. We're investigating the root cause to prevent recurrence in future.

item.title: Percy on Automate failures [resolved]
item.description: Customers using Percy on Automate experienced build failures between May 5th, 8:00 AM PDT and May 6th, 1:30 AM PDT. The issue has now been resolved, and Percy on Automate builds should be functioning as expected

item.title: AI features unavailable on Percy builds [resolved]
Intermittent Login failure for some users [resolved]
item.description: Some users might have faced issue while logging in during ~35 min window. No existing sessions were impacted.

item.title: Intermittent degraded visual diffs on Percy (Safari on iPhone) [resolved]
item.description: - Between February 8, 2026 (10:30 AM – 2:30 PM UTC) and February 9, 2026 (12:00 PM – 1:30 PM UTC) some customers may have noticed incorrect visual diffs on Percy (Safari on iPhone) - The issue occurred due to an incorrect screenshot capture where a “connection not private” error page was rendered instead of the expected page - The impact was limited, affecting a very small percentage of builds across a small number of organisations - Our engineering team has identified and addressed the underlying issue - All Percy services are now operating normally We sincerely apologise for any confusion or inconvenience this may have caused

item.title: API failures for percy builds [resolved]
item.description: Marking this as resolved as original incidence from Cloudflare is marked as resolved.

item.title: Unable to access Percy dashboard [resolved]
item.description: A subset of users were impacted by infinite reloads and unable to access percy dashboard while attempting to access a build URL on percy dashboard - which internally attempted sign in with browserstack.com. The issue is fixed as of 5:30 AM PST and all dashboard access should be working as expected now.

item.title: We are experiencing Percy build failures due to ongoing Cloudflare outage [resolved]
item.description: We have resumed normal operations and cleared up Percy backlog of builds. Build processing speed is back to normalcy

item.title: Percy is experiencing degraded rendering, leading to incorrect Visual differences [Underlying Cloudflare issue] [resolved]
item.description: We are currently experiencing degradation in visual difference impacting Percy builds due to an underlying Cloudflare issue. Affected builds may show snapshots with blank pages or missing assets, which can result in incorrect Visual differences Window : 10:30 PM PDT 22nd Oct - 1.47 AM PDT 23rd Oct

item.title: Percy Review Agent is experiencing degraded performance and partial outage [resolved]
Degraded Performance Due to AWS US-East-1 / LaunchDarkly Outage [resolved]
item.description: We are currently observing degraded performance from 6.30 AM - 7.45 AM PDT in Percy, primarily affecting build processing times and dashboard responsiveness. Our investigation indicates that this is due to an ongoing AWS US-East-1 regional outage impacting one of our critical third-party services - LaunchDarkly - which we use for configuration management and feature flag delivery. We are actively monitoring the situation and working with teams to mitigate impact. Builds may take longer to start or complete until the upstream issue is resolved.

item.title: Degraded Performance Due to AWS US-East-1 [resolved]
item.description: We are currently observing degraded performance from 12:20 PM PDT to 1 PM PDT [20th October] in Percy, primarily affecting build processing times and dashboard responsiveness. Our investigation indicates that this is due to an ongoing AWS US-East-1 regional outage impacting one of our critical third-party services . We are actively monitoring the situation and working with teams to mitigate impact. Builds may take longer to start or complete until the upstream issue is resolved.

item.title: Degradation with Percy Web builds [resolved]
item.description: On October 14th from 1.30 PM PDT to 8.30 PM PDT (14th October), Percy web experienced a slowness in processing of builds in majority of organisations. This was due to an underlying infrastructure degradation. Our team deployed a fix to address slow build times. All systems are now operating normally. We sincerely apologise for any disruption this may have caused.

item.title: Degraded Build Performance [resolved]
item.description: [Minor impact on build performance] On September 9th , our team deployed a fix to address the slow build times experienced by some organisations. This was due to an underlying infrastructure degradation. All systems are now operating normally. We sincerely apologise for any disruption this may have caused.
